package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/schema/ir"
)

type CustomModel struct{}

type CustomDescriptor struct{}

func (CustomDescriptor) Metadata() ir.Model {
	return ir.Model{}
}

func (CustomDescriptor) Scan(db.Row) (CustomModel, error) {
	return CustomModel{}, nil
}

var _ orm.ModelDescriptor[CustomModel] = CustomDescriptor{}
